description: You face Almagro's arcaded Plaza Mayor at night, the long colonnade glowing under warm lamplight. Wooden galleries and stone columns run across the frame left to right, their shadows falling across the empty cobbles. The square is silent now, but the lit arcades keep the unmistakable shape of La Mancha's most theatrical town.
